newsitem.title: USA: Zoltek says Q4, FY96 results beat forecast.
newsitem.headline: Zoltek says Q4, FY96 results beat forecast.

text.p: Zoltek Cos Inc said on Friday its earnings for the fourth quarter and fiscal 1996 beat analysts' expectations.
Earnings for the fourth quarter ended September 30 rose to $0.16 a share, double the $0.08 earned a year. It earned $0.45 a share in fiscal 1996, up 114 percent from $0.21 a year ago.
According to First Call, the mean estimate for the fourth quarter was $0.12 a share and the mean for fiscal 1996 was $0.42.
